_: United States outline from Natural Earth admin-0 countries, state boundaries from admin-1 states and the big lakes from the lakes file (public domain), projected Albers USA (conic equal-area 29.5°/45.5° for the lower 48; Alaska 55°/65°, Hawaii 8°/18° and Puerto Rico 17°/19° as insets — `insets` holds their scales (of `scale`), translations and the boxes they sit in: Alaska over Hawaii in the left column, Puerto Rico in the Atlantic). `far` is the neighbouring land around the lower 48 and `farAlaska` the land around Alaska (fills; `farEdge` / `farAlaskaEdge` their coastlines as open strokes), both drawn at half tone, `far` clipped to the frame plus `bleed` units on every side (a wide screen letterboxes the frame and the bands show land) — the page fades the map's edges, not the frame's. Built by scripts/build-map.mjs; map.js re-implements the projection to place cities. This is the 1:50m layer, drawn first.
